maria-cs: FYI—customer reported intermittent 403s when calling embeddings+generation in the same request through our API gateway sidecar. They say it used to work and stopped after a rollout this morning. Repro steps and logs below.

maria-cs: Repro (curl):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/infer \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer fk_live_XXXX' \
  -H 'X-Requested-Scopes: embeddings, generation, rerank' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

maria-cs: Response (customer): HTTP/1.1 403
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing required scope: generation"}

maria-cs: Our/api gateway access logs (proxied request):
```
req_id=req_20250315_abc123 method=POST path=/v1/infer header.X-Requested-Scopes="embeddings,gener" status=403
```

maria-cs: Notice header truncated to "embeddings,gener" — looks like the last scope got cut off by the sidecar.

jenna-support: @maria-cs can you paste the full req_id and the raw header captured on the sidecar? I want to correlate with token introspection. :eyes:

maria-cs: req_id=req_20250315_abc123 (same as above). Raw capture attached below (redacted key).
```
Authorization: Bearer fk_live_XXXX
X-Requested-Scopes: embeddings,gener
User-Agent: python-requests/2.31
```

ryan-oncall: If the header is truncated then the authorization layer will only see "gener" which doesn't match our scope canonical names (we expect "generation"). That would explain the insufficient_scope. Did anything change on the apigw/sidecar rollout?

sam-infra: Pinging infra — sidecar proxy v2.3.0 rolled out cluster-wide at 06:12 UTC. There's a known change where we started normalizing and truncating header values to 256 chars to mitigate a DoS vector; looks like a bug: we split on commas then substring each token to 5 chars in one codepath (ugh). Repro locally:
```
> echo 'embeddings, generation, rerank' | sidecar-normalize
embeddings,gener,rer
```

sam-infra: This explains why "generation" became "gener" and "rerank" became "rer" — our scope matcher does strict equality, so they fail.

jenna-support: Customer impact notes: multiple tenants with combined infer+embed calls may get silent permission denials (403) without clear message. We should provide workaround ASAP.

sam-infra: Hotfix plan: revert the truncation normalization, release v2.3.1 with the header handling fix. Also add a fallback check in auth to do prefix matching for legacy truncated tokens for the next 24 hours.

maria-cs: Workaround for affected customers: split the request into two calls (embeddings first, then generation) or use separate keys scoped only for generation to avoid multi-scope header. I'll DM affected customers with that guidance.

ryan-oncall: Please escalate to infra and security for regression verification. Add a short-term alert to catch sudden spikes in insufficient_scope errors post-deploy.

sam-infra: Opening infra-ops ticket: INFRA-5473. Patch branch created, running smoke tests now. Will push hotfix to canary and monitor. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout of sidecar v2.3.1-canary to cluster "us-west-2" at 2025-03-15T07:05:30Z.

maria-cs: I'll follow up with the customer once canary looks good. Thanks all. :pray:
